# glyphflow

> Lucide icons animated on the native Web Animations API, for Angular. Zero animation dependencies and real tree-shaking. MIT licensed.

glyphflow animates Lucide icons for Angular (`>=20.0.0 <23.0.0`) with no animation library. The `glyphflow/bots` entry point adds animated characters (`<gf-bot>`) with physical motion and an AI mode: they react to the steps of an agent through adapters for the Vercel AI SDK and Anthropic. Install with `npm i glyphflow`. The docs are available in English and Spanish.

## Product

- [Icons](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en): Browse the full catalog of animated Lucide icons for Angular. Hover to preview, click to copy the code, and import only the icons you use: one costs under 6 KB.
- [Examples](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/examples): Real UI controls — menus, toggles, notifications — with the exact code that animates them, side by side. Copy a pattern and drop it into your Angular app.
- [Path editor](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/editor): Edit an icon's outline node by node in the path editor, then hand the result straight to the choreography editor to animate it with glyphflow in Angular.
- [Lab](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/lab): Where default animation values get decided — durations, easings, and morph steps, tuned against real icons. Try the benches glyphflow uses to set its defaults.
- [Bots](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/bots): Animated characters with real physical motion on the native Web Animations API. Play with one, try its 20 gestures and watch it react to an AI agent live.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/getting-started): Install glyphflow with one command and animate your first icon in a few lines, no animation library required. Works with Angular 20, 21 and 22, MIT licensed.
- [Accessibility](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/accessibility): How glyphflow handles decorative vs. semantic icons, reduced motion, and keyboard navigation: one rule, not a matrix, so you never combine flags by hand.
- [SSR](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/ssr): glyphflow renders on the server with zero access to window or document — verified, not assumed. See what it does on the server and why there is no flicker.
- [API](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/api): Every input, output, and type glyphflow exports, with the guarantees that come with each one. The full public surface of the library, on a single page.
- [Migration](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/migration): Upgrading between glyphflow major versions — what changed and how to update your code. The v1 names still work, and this page says until when they do.
- [Comparison](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/comparison): glyphflow against lucide-angular, ng-icons, and Lottie — bundle weight, tree-shaking, and SSR support, measured with the method and versions listed on the page.
- [Verify your bundle](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/verify-your-bundle): Confirm your build only ships the icons you actually import, not the full catalog. Reproduce glyphflow's bundle numbers yourself with a few short commands.
- [Troubleshooting](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/troubleshooting): Common glyphflow issues and their fixes, from a blank icon to a broken build: icons that never animate, morphs that look wrong, empty name= and SSR failures.
- [Theming and color](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/theming): How glyphflow tokens interact with your app's light and dark themes: inherit currentColor, switch to dark mode and control the stroke width of every icon.
- [Using bots](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/en/docs/bots-guide): Install, shapes, gestures, customization and how to connect an AI agent to the glyphflow bots, with the Vercel AI SDK or Anthropic. Each piece imports alone.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/OrbeJmnz/glyphFlow): source code, issues and releases.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/glyphflow): the published package.

## Español

- [Iconos](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es): Explora el catálogo de iconos Lucide animados para Angular. Pasa el ratón para verlos, copia el código e importa solo los que uses: cada uno pesa menos de 6 KB.
- [Ejemplos](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/ejemplos): Controles de interfaz reales —menús, interruptores, notificaciones— con el código exacto que los anima, al lado. Copia un patrón y llévalo a tu app Angular.
- [Editor de trazos](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/editor): Edita el contorno de un icono punto por punto en el editor de trazos y pásalo directo al editor de coreografía para animarlo con glyphflow en tu app Angular.
- [Lab](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/lab): Donde se deciden los valores por defecto: duraciones, curvas y pasos de morph, ajustados contra iconos reales. Prueba los bancos que fijan los de glyphflow.
- [Bots](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/bots): Personajes animados con movimiento físico real sobre la Web Animations API nativa. Juega con uno, prueba sus 20 gestos y míralo reaccionar a un agente de IA.
- [Empezando](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/empezando): Instala glyphflow con un solo comando y anima tu primer icono en pocas líneas, sin librería de animación. Funciona con Angular 20, 21 y 22, con licencia MIT.
- [Accesibilidad](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/accesibilidad): Cómo trata glyphflow los iconos decorativos y semánticos, el movimiento reducido y el teclado: una regla, no una matriz, para no combinar banderas a mano.
- [SSR](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/ssr): glyphflow renderiza en el servidor sin acceso a window ni document — verificado, no supuesto. Mira qué hace en el servidor y por qué no hay parpadeo al cargar.
- [API](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/api): Cada input, output y tipo que exporta glyphflow, con las garantías que trae cada uno. La superficie pública completa de la librería, en una sola página.
- [Migración](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/migracion): Subir de versión mayor en glyphflow: qué cambió y cómo actualizar tu código. Los nombres de la v1 siguen funcionando, y esta página dice hasta cuándo.
- [Comparativa](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/comparativa): glyphflow contra lucide-angular, ng-icons y Lottie: peso del bundle, tree-shaking y soporte SSR, medidos con el método y las versiones que lista la página.
- [Verifica tu bundle](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/verifica-tu-bundle): Confirma que tu build solo empaqueta los iconos que de verdad importas, no el catálogo completo. Reproduce tú mismo los números del bundle con pocos comandos.
- [Solución de problemas](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/solucion-de-problemas): Problemas comunes de glyphflow y su arreglo, de un icono en blanco a un build roto: iconos que no animan, morphs raros, name= vacío y fallos de SSR al cargar.
- [Temas y color](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/temas-y-color): Cómo interactúan los tokens de glyphflow con el tema claro y oscuro de tu app: hereda currentColor, pasa a modo oscuro y controla el grosor del trazo.
- [Usar los bots](https://glyph-flow-zeta.vercel.app/es/docs/guia-de-bots): Instalación, formas, gestos, personalización y cómo conectar un agente de IA a los bots de glyphflow, con el Vercel AI SDK o Anthropic. Cada pieza va aparte.
